svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · P03 FORM FAMILY AND SHAPE FREEDOM
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · P03 · FORM FAMILY AND SHAPE FREEDOM
One system, five forms, any outline. The shape is a parameter of the product, not a product line.
A · THE FORM FAMILY · what changes, and what never changes
PHONE
one face live
TABLET
both faces, one surface
DESK · stand, second screen, keyboard accessory
GLASSES
glasses · polycarbonate lens, waveguide, micro display
prescription range · eye glow measured · AR and dimmed mode
THE RULE OF THE FORM CHANGE
A change of form must not change the identity, the protocol, the security model,
the permission set or the data location. that is what makes Budlum Leaf one
product family, not five products. the wallet authority moves the session.
B · THE SOFTENED PRISM FAMILY · Leaf 80, Leaf 160, Leaf 480
Upright B (40x32)
r 0.55 mm edges
Paired surfaces
magnetic edge couple

g.text: 1 · every body is a rectangular prism with small corner radius R = 3.20 mm (Leaf 160) so the screen stays a clean rectangle.
2 · all 12 prism edges are softened with r = 0.80 mm so no 90-degree sharp corner ever touches the hand (HARDWARE/06).
3 · the active screen area is 76.4 x 156.4 mm = 11 947 mm² per face (1.80 mm perimeter bezel), 100% open with zero cutouts.
4 · the bottom 15.0 mm transition zone houses 18 Ti/CFRP comb ribs and 3x 2.2 F thin-film 15 s supercapacitors.
5 · the upright B module (40 x 32 x 4.00 mm) seats on the top edge (y = +80 mm) and softens all its 90° edges at r = 0.55 mm.

svg.text: C · TWO FACES AS ONE SURFACE · and the interaction model that needs no keyboard
face A
face B
the seam
a virtual bezel of a stated width, or a continuous canvas with a
dead band of the panel pitch. state the value, measure the
misalignment after 10 000 bend cycles.
THE INPUT SET · one model, every form
touch on both faces, across the seam
proximity and hover: reacts before the touch
gesture: tap, pinch, swipe, grab, push, hold
gaze: a coarse pointer, never a payment approval
voice: the microphone array with a wake word
pen: passive on the touch layer, no digitizer
haptics: actuator in the rim or the module
recognition and false rates measured in three
light conditions · gate G-H10
the camera module is the input sensor of the
interaction layer, so the model needs no keyboard
steam-free rule: gesture and gaze frames run on
the validator only inside a signed session, and the
system stores the derived event, not the frame
local layer under 1 ms: echo, cursor, haptics
near layer 10 to 20 ms: gesture, gaze, dictation
D · AR AND VR · three modes on one system, and the claim rules
FIELD MODE · two faces, B module, spacer
the inter-pupillary distance is set by the spacer,
not by the device. this is the cheapest stereo path
the architecture offers.
GLASSES MODE

g.text: a polycarbonate lens with a waveguide and a micro display
in the frame. the lens stays clear, the wearer sees the image,
and the forward light ratio is measured, never claimed.
the prescription range, the drop and scratch behaviour and
the service route for a new lens are measured in O1 to O3.

svg.text: HAND-HELD MODE

g.text: the leaf as a window into an augmented scene with the camera
module as the tracker. the camera is the sensor, the validator
is the renderer, the panel is the window.

svg.text: CLAIM RULES

g.text: no "VR ready". report the measured field of view, the latency,
the comfort and the power for each mode.
reference, not target: one Android XR waveguide statement is 70
degrees of field of view, and a closed headset uses micro OLED.

svg.text: a two-face system is a natural stereo system · work order HO-8
E · SESSION CONTINUITY · the state lives in B.U.D., therefore the form and the provider can change
FORM STATE
session id, form, face set, input set,
energy state, counter
HANDOFF
target validator, resume token,
signature, single use
STATE HASH IN B.U.D.
the session survives a provider change,
a module hot swap and a form change

g.text: THE FOUR THINGS THE SESSION MUST SURVIVE
1 · a validator change during a live session
2 · a module hot swap: the camera module leaves and returns
3 · a link cut: the safe screen takes over, then the session resumes
4 · a form change: phone to tablet to desk to glasses to the field
gate G-H19 measures the grace period and the recovery. gate G-H20 measures the form change.
a stuck state after any of the four is a failure, not a degraded success.
